examples.hanzi: 周末我们带孩子去游乐园，那儿真是孩子们的乐园。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen dài háizi qù yóulèyuán, nàr zhēn shì háizimen de lèyuán.
examples.english: On the weekend we took the kids to the amusement park; it's truly a paradise for kids.

examples.hanzi: 对小狗来说，大草地就是它们的乐园。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiǎogǒu láishuō, dà cǎodì jiù shì tāmen de lèyuán.
examples.english: For puppies, a big meadow is their playground.

examples.hanzi: 加里是我大学时的室友。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ shì wǒ dàxué shí de shìyǒu.
examples.english: Gary was my roommate in college.

examples.hanzi: 加里每天晚上都去图书馆。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: Gary goes to the library every evening.

examples.hanzi: 请把名字前面的称呼去掉。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ míngzi qiánmiàn de chēnghu qùdiào.
examples.english: Please remove the title in front of the name.

examples.hanzi: 这个菜去掉辣椒会更好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài qùdiào làjiāo huì gèng hǎochī.
examples.english: This dish will taste better without the chili.

examples.hanzi: 他不想再跟那些人鬼混了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng zài gēn nàxiē rén guǐhùn le.
examples.english: He doesn't want to hang around with those people any more.

examples.hanzi: 你别整晚在网吧鬼混，明天还要上班。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zhěng wǎn zài wǎngbā guǐhùn, míngtiān hái yào shàngbān.
examples.english: Don't mess around at the internet café all night; you have work tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 我情愿走路，也不想挤地铁。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qíngyuàn zǒulù, yě bù xiǎng jǐ dìtiě.
examples.english: I'd rather walk than squeeze onto the subway.

examples.hanzi: 他情愿吃亏，也不愿跟朋友吵架。
examples.pinyin: Tā qíngyuàn chīkuī, yě bú yuàn gēn péngyou chǎojià.
examples.english: He'd rather lose out than quarrel with a friend.

examples.hanzi: 我可以为他担保，他是个诚实的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ wèi tā dānbǎo, tā shì gè chéngshí de rén.
examples.english: I can vouch for him; he is an honest person.

examples.hanzi: 这台冰箱有三年的担保期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái bīngxiāng yǒu sān nián de dānbǎoqī.
examples.english: This refrigerator has a three-year guarantee.

examples.hanzi: 这个场地可以容纳五百人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chǎngdì kěyǐ róngnà wǔbǎi rén.
examples.english: This venue can hold five hundred people.

examples.hanzi: 比赛的场地离地铁站很近。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài de chǎngdì lí dìtiězhàn hěn jìn.
examples.english: The competition venue is very close to the subway station.

examples.hanzi: 牛奶是一种白色的液体。
examples.pinyin: Niúnǎi shì yì zhǒng báisè de yètǐ.
examples.english: Milk is a kind of white liquid.

examples.hanzi: 实验室里的液体不能随便喝。
examples.pinyin: Shíyànshì lǐ de yètǐ bù néng suíbiàn hē.
examples.english: You must not drink the liquids in the lab casually.

examples.hanzi: 我永远不会忘记要报答你的恩情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn bú huì wàngjì yào bàodá nǐ de ēnqíng.
examples.english: I will never forget to repay your kindness.

examples.hanzi: 他用优异的成绩报答老师的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng yōuyì de chéngjì bàodá lǎoshī de bāngzhù.
examples.english: He repaid his teacher's help with excellent grades.

examples.hanzi: 医学文章里介绍了阴茎的功能。
examples.pinyin: Yīxué wénzhāng lǐ jièshào le yīnjīng de gōngnéng.
examples.english: The medical article describes the function of the penis.

examples.hanzi: 医学课本里有阴茎的结构图。
examples.pinyin: Yīxué kèběn lǐ yǒu yīnjīng de jiégòutú.
examples.english: The medical textbook has a diagram of the structure of the penis.

examples.hanzi: 父母的教导，我一直记在心里。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ de jiàodǎo, wǒ yìzhí jì zài xīn lǐ.
examples.english: I have always kept my parents' guidance in mind.

examples.hanzi: 老师耐心地教导每一个学生。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī nàixīn de jiàodǎo měi yí gè xuésheng.
examples.english: The teacher patiently instructs every student.

examples.hanzi: 学生也不应该有特权。
examples.pinyin: Xuésheng yě bù yīnggāi yǒu tèquán.
examples.english: Students should not have special privileges either.

examples.hanzi: 会员享有优先入场的特权。
examples.pinyin: Huìyuán xiǎngyǒu yōuxiān rùchǎng de tèquán.
examples.english: Members enjoy the privilege of priority admission.

examples.hanzi: 恐龙在六千多万年前就灭绝了。
examples.pinyin: Kǒnglóng zài liùqiān duō wàn nián qián jiù mièjué le.
examples.english: Dinosaurs went extinct more than sixty million years ago.

examples.hanzi: 我儿子最喜欢的玩具是恐龙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ érzi zuì xǐhuan de wánjù shì kǒnglóng.
examples.english: My son's favorite toy is a dinosaur.

examples.hanzi: 战士们英勇作战，保卫了家园。
examples.pinyin: Zhànshìmen yīngyǒng zuòzhàn, bǎowèi le jiāyuán.
examples.english: The soldiers fought bravely and defended their homeland.

examples.hanzi: 他的英勇行为受到了大家的称赞。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yīngyǒng xíngwéi shòudào le dàjiā de chēngzàn.
examples.english: His heroic act was praised by everyone.

examples.hanzi: 这根棍子太细了，撑不住他的体重。
examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn gùnzi tài xì le, chēng bu zhù tā de tǐzhòng.
examples.english: This stick is too thin to hold his weight.

examples.hanzi: 老爷爷拄着一根棍子慢慢走路。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo yéye zhǔzhe yì gēn gùnzi mànmàn zǒulù.
examples.english: The old man walks slowly, leaning on a stick.

examples.hanzi: 魔术师从帽子里变出了一只兔子。
examples.pinyin: Móshùshī cóng màozi lǐ biàn chū le yì zhī tùzi.
examples.english: The magician pulled a rabbit out of a hat.

examples.hanzi: 我想长大后当一名魔术师。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎng dà hòu dāng yì míng móshùshī.
examples.english: I want to become a magician when I grow up.

examples.hanzi: 我刚进门，电话恰好响了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng jìn mén, diànhuà qiàhǎo xiǎng le.
examples.english: The phone happened to ring just as I walked in.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋的大小恰好合适。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié de dàxiǎo qiàhǎo héshì.
examples.english: The size of these shoes is just right.

examples.hanzi: 米歇尔在一家银行工作。
examples.pinyin: Mǐxiē'ěr zài yì jiā yínháng gōngzuò.
examples.english: Michelle works at a bank.

examples.hanzi: 我昨天碰到了米歇尔，她还问起你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān pèngdào le Mǐxiē'ěr, tā hái wènqǐ nǐ.
examples.english: I ran into Michelle yesterday, and she asked about you.

examples.hanzi: 这个小女孩有一副甜美的嗓音。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo nǚhái yǒu yí fù tiánměi de sǎngyīn.
examples.english: This little girl has a sweet voice.

examples.hanzi: 昨晚我做了一个甜美的梦。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ zuò le yí gè tiánměi de mèng.
examples.english: I had a sweet dream last night.

examples.hanzi: 闯红灯是犯法的。
examples.pinyin: Chuǎng hóngdēng shì fànfǎ de.
examples.english: Running a red light is against the law.

examples.hanzi: 你这样做可是犯法，会被警察抓的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò kěshì fànfǎ, huì bèi jǐngchá zhuā de.
examples.english: What you're doing is illegal, and the police will arrest you.

examples.hanzi: 这个组织在当地的势力越来越大。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zǔzhī zài dāngdì de shìlì yuèláiyuè dà.
examples.english: This organization's influence in the area keeps growing.

examples.hanzi: 两家公司在市场上的势力差不多。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī zài shìchǎng shàng de shìlì chàbuduō.
examples.english: The two companies have about equal power in the market.

examples.hanzi: 他的工作得到了领导的认可。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò dédào le lǐngdǎo de rènkě.
examples.english: His work has been recognized by his superiors.

examples.hanzi: 我认可你的看法，咱们就这么办吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènkě nǐ de kànfǎ, zánmen jiù zhème bàn ba.
examples.english: I agree with your view; let's do it that way.

examples.hanzi: 他的住所离公司只有十分钟路程。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhùsuǒ lí gōngsī zhǐyǒu shí fēnzhōng lùchéng.
examples.english: His residence is only ten minutes from the company.

examples.hanzi: 这位作家的住所现在是一座博物馆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de zhùsuǒ xiànzài shì yí zuò bówùguǎn.
examples.english: This writer's former residence is now a museum.

examples.hanzi: 他向邻居求助，借了一把梯子。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng línjū qiúzhù, jiè le yì bǎ tīzi.
examples.english: He asked his neighbor for help and borrowed a ladder.

examples.hanzi: 如果迷路了，可以向警察求助。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ mílù le, kěyǐ xiàng jǐngchá qiúzhù.
examples.english: If you get lost, you can ask the police for help.

examples.hanzi: 让我们举杯，向老师致敬。
examples.pinyin: Ràng wǒmen jǔbēi, xiàng lǎoshī zhìjìng.
examples.english: Let's raise our glasses and pay tribute to our teacher.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影是向经典老片致敬的作品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì xiàng jīngdiǎn lǎopiàn zhìjìng de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: This film is a tribute to classic old movies.

examples.hanzi: 政府决定扩大这条马路的宽度。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng kuòdà zhè tiáo mǎlù de kuāndù.
examples.english: The government decided to widen this road.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅想扩大营业面积。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng xiǎng kuòdà yíngyè miànjī.
examples.english: This restaurant wants to expand its floor space.

examples.hanzi: 您好，我是新来的邻居。
examples.pinyin: Nín hǎo, wǒ shì xīn lái de línjū.
examples.english: Hello, I'm the new neighbor.

examples.hanzi: 您好！请问李经理在吗？
examples.pinyin: Nín hǎo! Qǐngwèn Lǐ jīnglǐ zài ma?
examples.english: Hello! Is Manager Li in?

examples.hanzi: 这块蛋糕要四分给我们几个人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dàngāo yào sì fēn gěi wǒmen jǐ gè rén.
examples.english: This cake is to be cut into four parts for the four of us.

examples.hanzi: 这个苹果要四分，大家都有份。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ yào sì fēn, dàjiā dōu yǒu fèn.
examples.english: This apple is to be quartered so everyone gets a share.

examples.hanzi: 我老家在一个很小的山村。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǎojiā zài yí gè hěn xiǎo de shāncūn.
examples.english: My hometown is in a very small mountain village.

examples.hanzi: 你的老家是哪儿的？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de lǎojiā shì nǎr de?
examples.english: Where is your hometown?

examples.hanzi: 这家酒店相对便宜，但是离市中心比较远。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn xiāngduì piányi, dànshì lí shì zhōngxīn bǐjiào yuǎn.
examples.english: This hotel is relatively cheap, but it is rather far from downtown.

examples.hanzi: 好和坏都是相对的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo hé huài dōu shì xiāngduì de.
examples.english: Good and bad are both relative.

examples.hanzi: 我只是单纯想帮你，没有别的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì dānchún xiǎng bāng nǐ, méiyǒu bié de yìsi.
examples.english: I simply want to help you; I have no other intention.

examples.hanzi: 她是个单纯的女孩，容易相信别人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè dānchún de nǚhái, róngyì xiāngxìn biérén.
examples.english: She is a naive girl who easily trusts others.

examples.hanzi: 冬天，我们在冰上打曲棍球。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān, wǒmen zài bīng shàng dǎ qūgùnqiú.
examples.english: In winter we play hockey on the ice.

examples.hanzi: 我哥哥是学校曲棍球队的队员。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì xuéxiào qūgùnqiú duì de duìyuán.
examples.english: My older brother is on the school hockey team.

examples.hanzi: 好些人都说这家店的面很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Hǎoxiē rén dōu shuō zhè jiā diàn de miàn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: Quite a few people say the noodles at this shop are delicious.

examples.hanzi: 他已经好些年没回过家了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng hǎoxiē nián méi huí guo jiā le.
examples.english: He hasn't been home for quite a few years.

examples.hanzi: 他这个人说话很可信。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège rén shuōhuà hěn kěxìn.
examples.english: What he says is quite trustworthy.

examples.hanzi: 这个消息听起来不太可信。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi tīng qǐlái bú tài kěxìn.
examples.english: This news doesn't sound very credible.

examples.hanzi: 他把全部资产都捐给了慈善机构。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ quánbù zīchǎn dōu juān gěi le císhàn jīgòu.
examples.english: He donated all of his assets to charity.

examples.hanzi: 房子是他们家最重要的资产。
examples.pinyin: Fángzi shì tāmen jiā zuì zhòngyào de zīchǎn.
examples.english: The house is their family's most important asset.

examples.hanzi: 请把锤子递给我。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chuízi dì gěi wǒ.
examples.english: Please hand me the hammer.

examples.hanzi: 工具箱里有锤子和螺丝刀。
examples.pinyin: Gōngjùxiāng lǐ yǒu chuízi hé luósīdāo.
examples.english: There are a hammer and a screwdriver in the toolbox.

examples.hanzi: 布什先生是那家公司的董事长。
examples.pinyin: Bùshí xiānsheng shì nà jiā gōngsī de dǒngshìzhǎng.
examples.english: Mr. Bush is the chairman of that company.

examples.hanzi: 新闻里正在报道布什的演讲。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén lǐ zhèngzài bàodào Bùshí de yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: The news is reporting on Bush's speech.

examples.hanzi: 他终于收到了公司的录取通知。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú shōudào le gōngsī de lùqǔ tōngzhī.
examples.english: He finally received the company's offer.

examples.hanzi: 这个专业今年只录取五十个学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhuānyè jīnnián zhǐ lùqǔ wǔshí gè xuésheng.
examples.english: This major admits only fifty students this year.

examples.hanzi: 这条河的东部有一片大森林。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de dōngbù yǒu yí piàn dà sēnlín.
examples.english: East of this river there is a large forest.

examples.hanzi: 东部的城市比西部发展得更快。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù de chéngshì bǐ xībù fāzhǎn de gèng kuài.
examples.english: The cities in the east have developed faster than those in the west.

examples.hanzi: 科学家想克隆一些濒危动物。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā xiǎng kèlóng yìxiē bīnwēi dòngwù.
examples.english: Scientists want to clone some endangered animals.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影讲的是克隆人的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì kèlóngrén de gùshi.
examples.english: This movie is about the story of clones.

examples.hanzi: 我哥哥现在在国外读书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge xiànzài zài guówài dúshū.
examples.english: My older brother is studying abroad now.

examples.hanzi: 这是一部从国外进口的车。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí bù cóng guówài jìnkǒu de chē.
examples.english: This is a car imported from abroad.

examples.hanzi: 请把手机交出来，考试时不能用。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shǒujī jiāo chūlái, kǎoshì shí bù néng yòng.
examples.english: Please hand in your phone; it can't be used during the exam.

examples.hanzi: 他不肯交出那把钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù kěn jiāochū nà bǎ yàoshi.
examples.english: He refused to hand over that key.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢把干酪放在面包上吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan bǎ gānlào fàng zài miànbāo shàng chī.
examples.english: I like eating cheese on bread.

examples.hanzi: 这家店的干酪种类特别多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de gānlào zhǒnglèi tèbié duō.
examples.english: This shop has an especially wide variety of cheeses.

examples.hanzi: 她去年做了整形手术，变化很大。
examples.pinyin: Tā qùnián zuò le zhěngxíng shǒushù, biànhuà hěn dà.
examples.english: She had cosmetic surgery last year and has changed a lot.

examples.hanzi: 这家整形医院在本市很有名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhěngxíng yīyuàn zài běn shì hěn yǒumíng.
examples.english: This plastic surgery hospital is well known in the city.

examples.hanzi: 一粒沙子掉进了我的眼睛里。
examples.pinyin: Yí lì shāzi diào jìn le wǒ de yǎnjing lǐ.
examples.english: A grain of sand got into my eye.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋里进了很多沙子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié lǐ jìn le hěn duō shāzi.
examples.english: There is a lot of sand in these shoes.

examples.hanzi: 这块地被一家公司占领了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dì bèi yì jiā gōngsī zhànlǐng le.
examples.english: This piece of land was taken over by a company.

examples.hanzi: 这家品牌很快占领了整个市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā pǐnpái hěn kuài zhànlǐng le zhěnggè shìchǎng.
examples.english: This brand quickly took over the whole market.

examples.hanzi: 他一直注视着窗外的雨。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zhùshì zhe chuāngwài de yǔ.
examples.english: He kept gazing at the rain outside the window.

examples.hanzi: 大家注视着舞台，等待演出开始。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā zhùshì zhe wǔtái, děngdài yǎnchū kāishǐ.
examples.english: Everyone watched the stage, waiting for the show to begin.

examples.hanzi: 请给这个文件加密，别让别人看到。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi zhège wénjiàn jiāmì, bié ràng biérén kàndào.
examples.english: Please encrypt this file so others can't see it.

examples.hanzi: 银行的数据都要加密保存。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng de shùjù dōu yào jiāmì bǎocún.
examples.english: All the bank's data has to be stored encrypted.

examples.hanzi: 我们订了一间海景套房。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dìng le yì jiān hǎijǐng tàofáng.
examples.english: We booked a sea-view suite.

examples.hanzi: 这间套房有两个卧室。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān tàofáng yǒu liǎng gè wòshì.
examples.english: This suite has two bedrooms.

examples.hanzi: 飓风过后，很多树都倒了。
examples.pinyin: Jùfēng guòhòu, hěn duō shù dōu dǎo le.
examples.english: After the hurricane, many trees had fallen.

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō jùfēng míngtiān huì lái.
